title: Assessing an Educational Intervention Program on Knowledge, Attitude and Behaviour Towards Pregnancy Prevention Based on Health Belief Model Amongst Adolescent Girls in Northern Ghana
brief_summary: The study is designed to assess the impact of an educational intervention program on the knowledge, attitude and behaviour towards pregnancy prevention based on Health Belief Model amongst adolescent girls in Northern Ghana. It is a randomised clustered controlled trial to be conducted on Senior High School students in Northern Ghana The study hypothesises that knowledge, attitude and behaviour of adolescents towards pregnancy prevention will differ between the groups.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Only unmarried adolescent female high school students shall be included in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Girls who do not want to participate and those who do not fall within the adolescent age group as well as married adolescents shall be excluded
